method: Each page below was fetched in full and read in this round. Fields are transcribed from the fetched text only. Nothing is inferred, and nothing in this file changes a published claim on its own: it is the dated evidence trail the register points at.
environment_note: Fetches come from a sandbox with no Amazon login and no Product Advertising API access. A home page or checkpoint returned in place of a product page is recorded as a fetch outcome, not as a verdict about a link.

pages.page_title: How To Add Breadcrumb (BreadcrumbList) Markup | Google Search Central | Documentation
lines_seen: A breadcrumb trail on a page indicates the page's position in the site hierarchy, and it may help users understand and explore a site effectively.
Feature availability: This feature is available on desktop in all regions and languages where Google Search is available.
How to add structured data: 1. Add the required properties. 2. Follow the guidelines. 3. Validate your code using the Rich Results Test.
pages.note: Used as the shape of the BreadcrumbList this build emits on guide and product pages. No claim is made here that a breadcrumb markup changes ranking; the documentation says it helps users understand and explore a site.

pages.note: The fetch landed on amazon.com's home page, not on a product detail page, so no ASIN could be read from this fetch and nothing in the register is changed by it. This is the same behaviour recorded on 2026-11-20 by an earlier session (FLG-031) and intermittently before that (FLG-004). It is evidence that a sandbox fetch cannot test these links, which is why validation is an owner step behind gate G-02, and it is not evidence that the link is dead or non-compliant (FLG-003 stays unresolved).

not_re_fetched_in_this_round.reason: Recorded so that this file cannot be read as a clean bill of health for rows it did not touch. Those rows keep the dated observations of the sessions that fetched them.

policy_compliance_of_this_round: No price, availability, star rating or review count from any fetched page is transcribed into this file or published by the site.
Fetched manufacturer pages were read for the specification lines this site cites, not for their marketing copy.
No Amazon trademark term was used as a keyword or bidding target in anything written in this round.
